name: Muse

whyMatters.en: Teignmouth trio formed in 1994. Prog/alt riffs, arpeggiated synths, and Matt Bellamy’s falsetto on Absolution (2003) and Black Holes and Revelations (2006) made the band a main UK arena-rock act of the 2000s.
whyMatters.zh: 廷茅斯三人组，1994 年成立。Absolution（2003）与 Black Holes and Revelations（2006）以 prog/alt riff、琶音合成器与 Matt Bellamy 假声，成为 2000 年代英国主要体育场摇滚乐队之一。

lyricQuotes: Come ride with me / Through the veins of history
My circuits blown by my mind

shortBio.en: Matt Bellamy trio; compressed guitars, arp synths, falsetto leads. Knights of Cydonia (2006) uses Morricone-style western pastiche in an arena single.
shortBio.zh: Matt Bellamy 三人组；压缩吉他、arp 合成器、假声主音。Knights of Cydonia（2006）以 Morricone 式西部拼贴写成体育场单曲。

body.en:
Formed in 1994 in Teignmouth. Origin of Symmetry (2001) and Absolution (2003) set heavily compressed guitars, arpeggiated synths, operatic falsetto, and sci-fi/conspiracy lyric frames. Rich Costey’s mixes push mid-range punch.

Black Holes and Revelations (2006) added Morricone-style western pastiche on Knights of Cydonia. Same UK generation as Radiohead; Muse kept riff-led, chant-ready arena arrangements rather than experimental retreat.
body.zh:
1994 年于廷茅斯组建。Origin of Symmetry（2001）与 Absolution（2003）确立高压缩吉他、琶音合成器、歌剧式假声与科幻/阴谋歌词框架。Rich Costey 混音推中频冲击。

Black Holes and Revelations（2006）在 Knights of Cydonia 加入 Morricone 式西部拼贴。与 Radiohead 同代；Muse 维持以 riff 与口号副歌为主的体育场编曲，而非实验撤退。

note.en: Origin of Symmetry single; fuzz riff and Bellamy tap/shred intro.
note.zh: Origin of Symmetry 单曲；fuzz riff 与 Bellamy 点弦/速弹前奏。

note.en: Wolstenholme bass line as main hook; Absolution compressed arena mix.
note.zh: Wolstenholme 贝斯线作主钩子；Absolution 压缩体育场混音。

note.en: Morricone pastiche, multi-section single from Black Holes and Revelations.
note.zh: 出自 Black Holes and Revelations 的 Morricone 拼贴、多段单曲。

body.en:
Plug In Baby and Hysteria use fuzz and tap guitar, Wolstenholme bass as melody, and Howard’s four-on-the-floor drive. Bellamy’s falsetto carries sci-fi and conspiracy lyric frames.

Absolution (2003) is mid-forward, loud, and built for large-venue choruses.
body.zh:
Plug In Baby 与 Hysteria 使用 fuzz/点弦吉他、Wolstenholme 贝斯作旋律，以及 Howard 的四拍驱动。Bellamy 假声承载科幻与阴谋歌词。

Absolution（2003）中频前置、响度高，副歌适合大型场地。

body.en:
Bellamy handles guitar, keys, and primary vocals; Wolstenholme bass and vocals; Howard drums. No permanent fourth member—live keyboards and guitar techs widen the stage sound.

The same three names run from early demos to Wembley-scale shows.
body.zh:
Bellamy 负责吉他、键盘与主唱；Wolstenholme 贝斯与和声；Howard 鼓。无固定第四成员——现场键盘与吉他 tech 扩大舞台声场。

从早期 demo 到 Wembley 级演出仍是这三个名字。

title.zh: 与 Radiohead 并列的体育场摇滚

body.en:
Radiohead moved toward experimental and electronic work; Muse kept riff, synth arp, and falsetto at arena scale. Knights of Cydonia (2006) is a frequent citation for maximal UK alternative rock of that year.

Queen and Rush pastiche appear as deliberate arrangement choices.
body.zh:
Radiohead 走向实验与电子；Muse 维持 riff、合成器 arp 与假声的体育场体量。Knights of Cydonia（2006）常被引作当年英国 alternative 摇滚的最大化写法。

Queen 与 Rush 拼贴是刻意的编曲选择。

note.en: Arena progressive rock with falsetto and heavy pedalboard use.
